rightsBasis.note: Original lecture notes authored by the instructor (Yu Wang). The instructor has flagged that some short passages or figures may have been drawn from published textbooks during prior course development. Coursewerk will not carry any such passage or figure into the package verbatim: text is rewritten originally in Coursewerk's own words from the underlying facts/concepts, and any figure is either self-generated (RDKit/matplotlib) or fetched from an openly-licensed source, never reproduced from a textbook. See docs/authoring-guidelines.md and format-contracts/deliverables.md (copyright section).
